verdict.rationale: Twilio documents a very broad API surface: over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products, usable over HTTPS or SDKs. That surface includes account-level settings such as default call recording, number search, purchase and porting, and regulatory bundles, which strongly suggests most UI actions can be done programmatically. However, no evidence explicitly states Console/API parity, and some flows such as toll-free verification are shown only as Console-driven. Missing for 10: explicit documented UI/API parity commitment, evidence that Console-only flows (e.g., toll-free verification) have API equivalents, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
